title: Bad
text: Bad. Isn't worth the money or the long wait for it to arrive. No follow up emails and I really don't understand what's so enigmatic about it, the reviews makes it seem like the god of pillows but really nothing fancy AT ALL. Smells so bad and the smell is very clingy!
